_why._note: Goal A = as high as possible with a small error. Stock position-controller gains: on ArduCopter at 100 m in wind, PSC_VELXY_I 2 + PSC_POSXY_P 1.5 changed the drift by less than the spread between runs.
_why.send_speed: sending speed made the hold worse in every test (100 m: 2.4 to 3.2 m against 0.8 m).
_why.cov_scale: a smaller covariance gave more wobble and a worse worst case.
